summary: Frontend-only smoke of Zikirhane Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Most core flows work: splash → onboarding (skip + 3-step next) → home, big tap-anywhere counter, undo, reset-with-confirm, target picker (33/99/100/500), dhikr picker (6 built-ins), home toggles (vibration/sound/keepawake), Zikirlerim tab (Namaz Sonrası + Esma cards + dhikr list), Esma detail tap/count/fav/reset, custom-dhikr create (visible in list with edit/delete testIDs), İstatistikler daily goal card + reset-all, Ayarlar all switches + goal chips + custom goal + theme toggle (dark↔light applies live), AsyncStorage persistence works (counter 4 preserved and onboarding not re-shown after reload). Turkish UI renders correctly, no red screens on happy paths, no missing tabs. One CRITICAL bug found: Tesbihat crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading target)' at app/tesbihat.tsx:75 when transitioning between steps under fast taps — race condition causes stepIdx to exceed STEPS bounds. Several expected testIDs are missing (weekly-chart, top-dhikrs-list, dhikr-target-input, dhikr-transliteration-input, esma-fav-chip). Deprecated packages detected: none (expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch not used).

ui_bugs.issue: Red-screen crash: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading target)' at app/tesbihat.tsx:75. Occurs when transitioning from step 2 → 3 (or reaching the final step) because setStepIdx((i)=>i+1) can fire twice when the user taps rapidly at the boundary: the tap handler checks the stale `step.target` in a closure while count>=target, so stepIdx overshoots to 3 and STEPS[3] is undefined. Reference: /app/frontend/app/tesbihat.tsx:46-69, 75.

action_items: FIX CRITICAL: Guard Tesbihat onTap against overshoot. Either (a) also gate the transition on `stepIdx < STEPS.length - 1` inside a functional setStepIdx using its previous value and set count synchronously (no setTimeout), or (b) set a local `transitioning` ref/state at boundary and early-return further taps until state updates. Currently double-fires can push stepIdx to 3.

Add missing testIDs: weekly-chart (İstatistikler 'Son 7 Gün'), top-dhikrs-list (İstatistikler 'En Sık Yapılan Zikirler'), dhikr-target-input & dhikr-transliteration-input (custom-dhikr), esma-fav-chip (esma favoriler chip).
Add diacritic-insensitive search for Esmaül Hüsna (normalize both query and name to lowercased ASCII before matching).
Replace deprecated 'shadow*' style props with 'boxShadow' string; replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents on Animated.View in home.
critical_code_review_comments: app/tesbihat.tsx onTap has a classic stale-closure race: at boundary next>=step.target, setCount(next) + setTimeout(setStepIdx(i=>i+1)+setCount(0)) is not atomic — subsequent rapid taps re-enter with an updated count but stale stepIdx and re-schedule setStepIdx increment. Move all transition state into a single reducer or use a ref to lock further taps until transition completes.
app/(tabs)/index.tsx:167 uses `pointerEvents='none'` prop instead of style — React Native web deprecated this.

app/(tabs)/istatistikler.tsx and app/custom-dhikr.tsx are missing testIDs promised in the PRD (weekly-chart, top-dhikrs-list, dhikr-target-input, dhikr-transliteration-input) — makes automated regression brittle.

rca_of_issue: Tesbihat crash — RCA: In /app/frontend/app/tesbihat.tsx onTap (lines 46-69), when the counter reaches step.target the code calls setCount(next) synchronously and schedules setStepIdx((i)=>i+1)+setCount(0) via setTimeout(350ms). React batches state so `count` and `stepIdx` do not both flip at the same time. If the user taps again during the 350ms window, the handler runs with the OLD `step` (via closure) and OLD stepIdx (not yet incremented). Since count is already at target, next>=step.target is true, and `stepIdx < STEPS.length - 1` is still true, so ANOTHER setStepIdx((i)=>i+1) is scheduled. After both timeouts resolve, stepIdx becomes 3 → STEPS[3] undefined → step.target throws at line 75. Reproduction: navigate to Tesbihat, tap counter 33+ times fast; crash appears at 2→3 boundary. Mitigation: gate the boundary with a transitioning ref, e.g., `if (transitioningRef.current) return;` set to true before scheduling the timeout and false inside the timeout after both setStepIdx and setCount(0). Alternatively, drop the setTimeout and transition synchronously: setStepIdx(prev => prev < STEPS.length - 1 ? prev + 1 : prev); setCount(0).
